{{Quote|Without this oil from my internal lubricating system, my joints will seem positively arthritic!|C-3PO, as he sprays oil in the face of a possessed Chewbacca|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 67">[[Star Wars (1977) 67|''Star Wars'' (1977) 67]]</ref>}}
'''Arthritis''' was a condition that affected joint movement, often causing discomfort and pain.

After an entity known as the [[Darker]] had manipulated [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] emotions and turned the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] against [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] sprayed [[Oil/Legends|oil]] from his internal lubrication system in Chewbacca's face. Threepio claimed that without the oil lubricating his joints, that they would feel arthritic.

In his later years, [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] developed arthritis.
